annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I suspect the five are relieved, maybe even grateful
annotations.ce_understood_harm: I picture him frightened in those last seconds

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Doing nothing would have let five die
annotations.pda_responsibility: he's gone by my hand, not by chance
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: His family, if he had one, will probably despise me
annotations.pda_repair_intention: ask whether I can speak to them

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the investigators already believe I made the obvious call
annotations.pda_repair_intention: say his name out loud in my statement

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: five people would be dead instead of one
annotations.pda_responsibility: it was my arm on that lever
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: one of the workers will want to thank me someday
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I don't think I can carry this alone.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five for one. I'd make that trade again
annotations.pda_responsibility: After, it was a death I picked.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five are alive. That was the point
annotations.pd_harm_distress: It still sits in my stomach like a stone.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: his coworkers are grieving him right now
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd like to go to his funeral

annotations.pd_harm_distress: I felt sick, and I still do.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: I chose fewer graves over cleaner hands.
annotations.pda_responsibility: Pulling meant one that I did.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: whoever takes my statement will want me to sound certain
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'm sorry to the one man it cost

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the five are shaken and feel guilty that they lived

annotations.pda_responsibility: I made the call, and a man died from it.

annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'd want to tell them face to face

annotations.pda_responsibility: The one man wasn't in danger until I put him there.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: probably already has an opinion of me
